name: conqueror_evil_charge
author: HexPiece 2.5.1
description: Conqueror's Haki charge (evil: disturbing): the head drops forward limp, the arms hang like a puppet's; as it fills the head creeps up and over to an unnatural tilt, staring sideways, the shoulders hitch, the head jerks, the fingers twitch, more and more often, the body swaying slowly.
